title: File pack ideas with evidence, based_on links and concept links
description:
In pack_stories (using ideas/items.py ItemStore / file_idea_item and story_reporting.link_reference_to_story):
- targets = entity:reference:<lineage> for every cited Reference, so based_on/uses_evidence links are written.
- front matter generated.origin = "context-pack", generated.evidence = {packId, signal, anchor, window, surprise, citedConcepts, citedMessages}.
- each cited concept becomes a current related_to edge item -> semanticNode, metadata.provenance "derived", so the idea shows on the concept page.
- body ends with an "Evidence" section: the signal in one sentence ("9 accepted References linked to #voice-cloning in 14 days, against 2.1 expected"), References with published/added dates, concepts as hashtags.
- every idea passes HumanusGate (ideas/gate.py) unchanged; one soft ReviewRequest per run as today; ideas stay in the Idea stage.
Tests: filing writes based_on for each cited Reference and the evidence front matter; a refused idea is not filed.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
